L183: 
L184: 18 inches is the Draco standard on every necklace and pendant here, customizable at checkout. 16 inches sits at the base of the throat and works under an open collar. 18 inches falls at the collarbone, which is why it is the default. Longer drops sit over a neckline rather than framing it.
